ConversationRecentRevision.description: Opaque equality-only version of the Host recent view. Scoped to provider, authenticated reader and instance generation. Not the replay eventCursor or a Provider enumeration/activity version; clients must never parse or increment it.

limit.description: 本页最多读取的记录数，受字段范围约束。

ConversationRecentRequest.description: Final Host-sorted recent view; default limit 20, maximum 100. Reader scope comes only from authenticated context. Cursor binds scope, provider, generation, snapshot revision, time cutoff and position. Expiration returns recent_cursor_expired; tampering or binding mismatch returns invalid_cursor. Membership and pagination are independent from conversation.list.

ConversationRecentResponse.description: Page of one complete globally sorted snapshot. Every summary carries authoritative reader-scoped readState. revision remains constant across pages. snapshotCursor is captured before Provider queries and is the exact replay fence to pass as event.subscribe.afterCursor.

ConversationRecentChangedEvent.description: Invalidate and refetch this reader's recent view, cancelling old tail pages. Contains no member IDs or readerScope. If published provider-wide for shared replay, revision is a provider-wide invalidation revision used consistently by snapshots; it must not expose another reader's private revision. Never use revision as eventCursor.
